title: Angleton and others on George C. Marshall's team

plain: Many of the key figures in the hidden history of UFOs, including James Jesus Angleton, who went on to become a central figure at the CIA, the US spy agency, all seem to have served on the team of General George C. Marshall, the top American general of the Second World War. Pippa Malmgren, appearing alongside her father Harald Malmgren, a former presidential advisor, says this is what she keeps finding, without naming a source, and she also mentions John F. Kennedy and James Forrestal. If true, it would mean one close-knit circle from the war years shaped how secrets were kept afterward.
